J-03.name: Seller-control scenario is identified
J-03.notes: PROMOTED failing -> PASSING in iter-4 (first new-scenario journey since the iter-1 foundation). NOTE: the seller path was NOT pre-built despite the iter-3 journey-history note claiming so — iter-4 decomposer's code inspection found classifier.py had only buyer_control+unclear, simulated.py only _buyer_control_stream(), and SIM-SELLER emitted zero events (it would have hung at cold-start unclear). So this was net-new backend work: STATE_SELLER_CONTROL gate + _seller_confidence/_seller_observations + config thresholds (min_aggressive_sell_ratio=0.60, max_sell_price_impact=-0.02 NEGATIVE) + _seller_control_stream() + 7 new deterministic tests, all at full depth. Browser-verified on SIM-SELLER: tape state Seller Control @ confidence 0.892 (>= 0.60); aggressive_sell_ratio 0.961 high; sell_price_impact -0.370 NEGATIVE (the keystone mirror price-impact guard — code-confirmed sell_impact <= -0.02 AND 3 guard unit tests reject zero/positive impact as control); descending SELL prints; observations 'Seller aggression increasing'/'Price falling on sell prints'/'Spread stable and narrow'; event log 'Tape state changed to seller_control'; live over WS, no reload. First on-screen rose render via dynamic stateColor('seller_control') measured: headline text-rose-400 rgb(251,113,133), bar fill bg-rose-500 rgb(244,63,94), via getComputedStyle + base-selector stylesheet probe (NOT eye), explicitly NOT slate rgb(226,232,240). Backend 31/31 green; coherence PASS (rides the existing Tape-state contract row, one producer/one endpoint). Evidence: TC-11-sim-seller-seller-control.png, UT-02-seller-control.png, UT-03-color-probe.png.

J-04.name: Bid absorption is detected (price impact, not aggression)
J-04.notes: Not built/verified yet — the NEXT target (full depth). This is the DEFINING price-impact case and the most safety-critical anti-goal surface: high aggressive SELL volume WITHOUT a meaningful price drop => bid_absorption, NOT seller_control. seller_control (J-03, iter-4) is now built with its negative-impact guard, which is exactly the prerequisite that makes the absorption-vs-control distinction testable (the difference is whether the quote actually fell). Net-new backend work: absorption features (absorption_score, bid_refresh_score), the bid_absorption classifier branch, a SIM-BIDABS stream (sells hit a bid that REFRESHES at the same price => ~0 sell impact), config cutoffs, and deterministic guard tests asserting absorption (not seller_control) is reached. Amber color path (text-amber-400/bg-amber-500) confirmed present in the served bundle (iter-3 latent-class guard). FOLD IN the deferred stream-status-dot consolidation here (drive the top-bar dot from snapshot.stream_status, not client connStatus) — absorption/no-data exercises stale/closed states.

J-05.name: Ask absorption is detected (price impact, not aggression)
J-05.notes: Not built/verified yet — the mirror of J-04, to pair with or immediately follow it (full depth). High aggressive BUY volume WITHOUT a meaningful price rise => ask_absorption, NOT buyer_control. Now that buyer_control (J-02) and seller_control (J-03) both exist with their price-impact guards, ask_absorption is a clean extension (ask refreshes at the same price => ~0 buy impact). Needs ask_refresh_score + the ask_absorption branch + a SIM-ASKABS stream + guard tests. Amber color path confirmed in-bundle (iter-3 latent-class guard). Critical price-impact anti-goal.

J-06.name: Unclear / choppy tape is reported as unclear
J-06.notes: Not built/verified yet (a SIM-CHOP scenario emitting mixed/choppy flow does not exist; the ticker is reserved-and-silent). The unclear state itself already renders correctly in amber — iter-4 UT-07 showed SIM-BIDABS (silent) honestly holds 'Unclear' amber rgb(251,191,36) @ conf 0.100 'Warming up' with an empty event log (no over-fire) — but J-06's acceptance needs an actively choppy stream that resolves to unclear with low confidence by mixed signals/wide spread/low trade_speed, not merely a silent provider. Honest-uncertainty anti-goal. Likely lean once SIM-CHOP is authored, after J-04/J-05.

J-08.name: REST and the live UI agree (single source of truth)
J-08.notes: Held GREEN — re-verified iter-4 as the required-still-passing single-source-of-truth guard, now also across the new seller state. TC-13: with SIM-SELLER stabilized, UI state 'Seller Control' / confidence 0.848 == REST GET /tape/SIM-SELLER/state tape_state=seller_control / confidence=0.8476259 (matches to display precision @ 3dp). One engine value per metric; no UI-side recomputation. Coherence PASS confirms seller_control is produced once by TapeStateClassifier and served by the one canonical /state endpoint (re-exposed read-only by /summary + WS), with no new/parallel producing path. First proven green iter-2 (buyer), held iter-3, extended to the seller state iter-4.
